production.format_and_medium.summary: If a public record is stored in a digital format that is sortable, the custodian shall provide a copy in a sortable format; if stored in a searchable format, in a searchable format.

The custodian need not produce in the sortable/searchable format if doing so would violate a copyright or licensing agreement, or if it is not technologically or practically feasible to remove withholdable information or to provide the format without purchasing new software.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person may inspect any public record at reasonable times, except as otherwise provided in the Act or by law; no requester qualification is imposed.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester need not state a purpose or reason to inspect general public records; the right runs to any person at reasonable times.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: CORA imposes no residency or citizenship requirement; the right to inspect runs to 'any person' without geographic qualification.

custody.referral_to_proper_custodian.summary: If the requested records are not in the custody or control of the person to whom application is made, that person shall so notify the applicant in writing and, if known, state which custodian has custody or control.

Clarification.deny.label: Deny as vague / overbroad
Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

Estimate-Fee.proc.label: No → proceed to work; collect at end
Estimate-Fee.proc.note: Collect-at-end is the default path wherever production is NOT statutorily conditioned on prepayment.

Records-Search.prog.label: BUT extraction/programming of EXISTING
Records-Search.prog.note: Programming-≠-creation loop is TX 552.231 only; the broader no-duty-to-create concept (16 states) is context, not an activator.

response.extension_grounds.summary: The three-working-day period may be extended when extenuating circumstances exist, but the extension shall not exceed seven working days.
response.extension_grounds.clock_spec: ceiling: up to 7 additional working days beyond the presumptive 3-working-day period

response.extension_limit.summary: Extenuating circumstances can never apply to a request that relates to a single, specifically identified document.

response.extension_notice.summary: A finding that extenuating circumstances exist must be made in writing by the custodian and provided to the requester within the three-working-day period.
response.extension_notice.clock_spec: written finding due within 3 working days of the request (before extension takes effect)

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: The custodian may charge a fee not to exceed twenty-five cents per standard page for a copy of a public record.

fee.labor_charge.summary: After the first hour, the custodian may charge a fee for research and retrieval of public records not to exceed thirty dollars per hour.

A custodian may impose a research-and-retrieval fee only if, before receiving the request, it has posted on its website or otherwise published a written policy specifying the applicable conditions and the amount of any current fee.

fee.nonstandard_rate.summary: For a copy, printout, or photograph in a format other than a standard page, the custodian may charge a fee not to exceed the actual cost of providing it.

fee.free_allowance.summary: The custodian shall not impose any charge for the first hour of time expended in research and retrieval of public records.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: No transmission fee may be charged to the requester for transmitting public records via electronic mail.

custody.custodian_definition_and_role.summary: The 'custodian' is the official custodian or any authorized person having personal custody and control of the public records in question; this identifies who must respond and drives routing.
The custodian may make and enforce rules reasonably necessary for the protection of the records and to prevent unnecessary interference with the discharge of duties.
